Local distribution change: WOFF2-only math fonts.

Keep all 20 KaTeX font families/styles in WOFF2 format. Remove the duplicate
WOFF and TTF files and their fallback URLs from both dist/katex.css and
dist/katex.min.css. JavaScript, font metrics, glyph coverage, and licenses
are unchanged. Theme fonts outside this directory are unchanged.

When updating KaTeX, reapply this change to both CSS files together with the
font files, then verify all font-face URLs and formula rendering.
